title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 2: Boot Camp

scenes.say: The bus pulls in before sunrise. Fort Jackson. No more block. No more name.
scenes.visual: a military bus arriving at a training base before dawn, headlights in fog, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: A drill sergeant's voice hits harder than any street fight ever did.
scenes.visual: a drill sergeant hat in silhouette shouting at a line of recruits, low angle, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali's hair hits the floor. The kid from Newark goes with it.
scenes.visual: dark hair falling onto a barbershop floor under fluorescent light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: They tell him when to sleep, when to eat, when to breathe.
scenes.visual: rows of identical bunks in a barracks, boots lined perfectly under each, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: On the block, nobody told him nothing. Here, everybody does.
scenes.visual: recruits marching in formation on a parade field, dust in the morning sun, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He wants to swing. He wants to quit. He wants to run home.
scenes.visual: a recruit gripping a rifle on a muddy obstacle course, rain falling, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: But home is a cell, and he knows it.
scenes.visual: an empty prison cell with light through the bars, cold steel blue tones, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: So he runs. He crawls. He climbs.
scenes.visual: boots climbing a rope wall against a grey sky, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Week by week, the anger turns into something with a direction.
scenes.visual: a recruit running alone on a track at dawn, long shadow behind him, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Graduation day. His mother in the stands. She finally sees her son standing straight.
scenes.visual: a proud mother in bleachers at a military graduation, flags in the background, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Three. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a soldier's dress cap resting on a folded uniform, warm light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 2 of 25: Boot Camp. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
